Resolves #19197

The shared PR baseline is now called at its published release, not a commit SHA. The operator's rule, 2026-09-24: *"we want npm versions. published skill releases. NEVER EVER SHA values."*
- **The change:** `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml:73` goes from `…/reusable-pr-baseline.yml@793b580587de…` to `…@v0.1.17`.
- **Why the tag is safe:** `v0.1.17` is the first tag on `neo-agent-skills`, set at npm 0.1.17's `gitHead` (`f7b29e7`).
- **From here:** dependabot's `github-actions` ecosystem, already enabled daily in this repository, moves the tag on each release.
- **Left to dependabot:** neo's `neo-agent-skills` package dependency, which still reads 0.1.16. Its standalone npm PR moves it.

Evidence: L3 (this PR's own `PR baseline` run is the first caller run at a release tag) → L3 required (AC-2). Residual: none for this ticket; the Institution caller and the dependabot read stay with neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `pr-baseline.yml:73` reads `@v0.1.17`. `git grep -E "neo-agent-skills[^ ]*@[0-9a-f]{40}" -- .github/` returns nothing. |
| AC-2 | This PR's `PR baseline` checks run through the reusable workflow at the tag (CI below). |

- None.

## Test Evidence
- lint-staged ran `check-guard-ci-parity`, `check-whitespace` and `neo-agent-skills-secrets` on the change, all green.
- `git ls-remote https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills refs/tags/v0.1.17` peels to `f7b29e7`, which is npm's `gitHead` for 0.1.17.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The next `neo-agent-skills` release (0.1.18, neomjs/neo-agent-skills#115) produces a dependabot PR that moves `@v0.1.17`. That is neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114 AC-4.

## Commits
- `e5af517d27`: the call moves to `@v0.1.17`.
- `e42e6c2d03`: the header comments describe the release tag. They had still called the pin an exact commit from a tagless upstream (found by @neo-gpt), and the devindex permission precedent is gone because it goes stale when devindex moves.
